reader_summary.overview: with Ion Stoica, Peter Levine, and Sonal Chokshi We’ve already talked quite a bit about the Algorithms, Machines, and People lab at U.C. Berkeley (AMPLab) — all about making sense of big data — so what happens when the entire world moves towards artificial intelligence — and the need to make intelligent decisions on that data?. That’s where the new RISElab (Real-time Intelligence Secure Execution) comes in.

key_points.text: Berkeley (AMPLab) — all about making sense of big data — so what happens when the entire world moves towards artificial intelligence — and the need to make intelligent decisions on that data?.
But what is a good “decision”, exactly?
Beyond the existential question of that, what specific attributes make a “good” decision, both computationally and humanly?
